title: After three first-round picks this year, Jets have three more first-round picks next year

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: After three first-round picks this year, Jets have three more first-round picks next year
sources.description: If the Jets ever turn things around, they may look back on the 2026 and 2027 NFL drafts as the time when they stockpiled talent to become a winner.
